Class AbstractAiProvider

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.event.BasicPropertyChangeSource
uno.anahata.asi.agi.provider.AbstractAiProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AnthropicProvider, GeminiAiProvider, OpenAiChatCompletionsProvider, OpenAiResponsesProvider
public abstract class AbstractAiProvider extends BasicPropertyChangeSource
The abstract base class for all AI model providers, now with model caching. Its primary responsibilities are to discover available models and manage API keys.
Author:
anahata

  • Field Details

    • priority

      private int priority
      The sorting priority for this provider. Lower values indicate higher priority (pinned to top).

    • asiContainer

      private transient AbstractAsiContainer asiContainer
      A transient reference to the parent container. This allows providers to access shared resources like the executor service.

    • uuid

      private String uuid
      The unique UUID for this specific provider instance. Crucial for distinguishing between multiple instances of the same provider class (e.g., two different Ollama endpoints).

    • baseUrl

      private String baseUrl
      The base URL of the provider's API endpoint.

      This allows the provider to target official cloud services or alternative backends like local proxies, Ollama, or specialized vendor endpoints.

    • apiKeysFile

      private String apiKeysFile
      An optional custom file path for this provider's API keys file. If null or empty, defaults to ~/.anahata/asi/<uuid>_api_keys.txt.

    • displayName

      private String displayName
      The user-facing display name for this instance (e.g., 'Groq Cloud').

    • description

      private String description
      The user-facing description of this instance.

    • keysAcquisitionUri

      private String keysAcquisitionUri
      The URI where users can acquire API keys for this provider.

    • tokenizerType

      private TokenizerType tokenizerType
      The type of tokenizer used by this provider. This determines how accurately the Context Window Garbage Collector can estimate the token count before making an API call.

    • apiKeyRequired

      private boolean apiKeyRequired
      Whether this provider requires an API key to function. If false, the ASI will allow requests even if the key pool is empty (e.g. local Ollama).

    • enabled

      private boolean enabled
      Whether this provider is enabled and should be offered to the user.

    • automaticallyRegisterNewlyDiscoveredModels

      private boolean automaticallyRegisterNewlyDiscoveredModels
      Whether to automatically register and persist newly discovered models when API discovery runs.

    • currentKey

      private transient String currentKey
      The API key currently in use by this provider. Captured during key rotation.

    • keyPool

      private volatile List<String> keyPool
      The internal cache of loaded API keys, reloaded from disk on change.

    • round

      private final AtomicInteger round
      Atomic counter for round-robin key selection.

    • keyPoolLastModified

      private transient long keyPoolLastModified
      The last-modified timestamp of the API keys file when it was last loaded from disk.

    • models

      private transient List<AbstractModel> models
      The master list of persistent model entities for this provider (loaded from disk .kryo files).

    • cachedApiModels

      private transient List<AbstractModel> cachedApiModels
      The transient list of models returned directly by the provider's API for diffing and alerting.

    • MARKUP_TABLE_HEADER

      public static final String MARKUP_TABLE_HEADER
      Markdown table header for provider listings.

    • initialize

      public void initialize() throws Exception
      Initializes this provider after instantiation and container binding. Subclasses can override to perform custom setup before or after calling super.initialize().
      Throws:
      Exception - if provider initialization fails.

    • persist

      public void persist() throws IOException
      Persists this AI provider entity directly to disk in the container's providers directory (~/.anahata/asi/<hostApp>/<version>/providers/<uuid>.kryo).
      Throws:
      IOException - If creating the directory or saving the file fails.
      IllegalStateException - If the parent container is null or uuid is null or blank.

    • remove

      public void remove() throws IOException
      Deletes the persisted .kryo file for this AI provider from disk and removes it from its parent container registry.
      Throws:
      IOException - If deleting the file fails.
      IllegalStateException - If the parent container is null or uuid is null or blank.

    • loadModelsFromDisk

      public List<AbstractModel> loadModelsFromDisk() throws IOException
      Loads all persisted models from this provider's models directory on disk into memory.

      Implements resilient per-model deserialization: if a model cache file is corrupt or in an incompatible legacy format, it is quarantined to the models/unloadable/ directory and a notification is recorded in the parent container without failing the provider initialization.

      Returns:
      The list of models loaded from disk and bound to this provider.
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading the models directory fails.

    • addModels

      public void addModels(List<AbstractModel> modelsToAdd) throws IOException

    • findModels

      public List<AbstractModel> findModels(String query, List<ResponseModality> modalities)
      Finds and filters models within this provider matching a regex/text query AND all requested response modalities.
      Parameters:
      query - Optional regex or text query to match against model ID, display name, description, supported actions, or modalities.
      modalities - Optional list of target response modalities (e.g. [IMAGE, AUDIO]). The model must support all listed modalities.
      Returns:
      A list of matching models.

    • isEffectivelyEnabled

      public boolean isEffectivelyEnabled()
      Checks if this provider is effectively enabled and ready for active model requests.

      A provider is effectively enabled if isEnabled() is true AND either it does not require an API key (e.g. local Ollama) or at least one valid API key is configured.

      Returns:
      true if enabled and properly keyed for requests.
